meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 装上后,它先给改动范围内的代码补上回归测试并跑绿,锁定现有行为,再按类别分批清理 AI 生成的代码味道,最后过测试、lint、类型检查等质量门;验证不通过就回退或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop、去掉最近改动里的 AI 味道时接管;默认范围是分支相对 main 的 diff,也可改为指定的文件列表。

say.text: 把当前分支相对 main 的改动清理一下 AI 味道
say.note: 先补回归测试跑绿,再分批清理

say.text: 对 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 做 deslop
say.note: 按你给的文件列表作为清理范围

say.text: 清理后跑测试、lint 和类型检查,不过就回退
say.note: 走质量门验证,失败则回退或直接改

howto.what_en: After install, it locks behavior with green regression tests, then runs a categorized multi-pass cleanup of AI-slop patterns in the changed files, then checks quality gates; failed verification triggers revert or direct edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs main; an explicit file list can be passed instead.

say_en.text: Deslop the changes on this branch vs main
say_en.note: Adds regression tests first, then batch cleans

say_en.text: Run deslop on src/foo.py and src/bar.py
say_en.note: Uses the explicit file list as scope

say_en.text: Clean it up and run tests, lint, typecheck
